notes.title: The ART of Five Nights At Stickman
notes.content:
THE ART:

UI:


The UI is ofcourse very much inspired by FNAF 1,

The visual assets of the camera button, the doors, the power buttons.

I'd say the 2 biggest differences is the way the office looks and the red flashing lights during gameplay.


AUDIO:


The audio design is minimalistic, but haunting enough to shiver thy timbers.



It's hard to compare it to FNAF 1, as nearly all sounds are different in approach.


CAMERA LOCATIONS & STICKMEN:


Ofcourse the BIG thing that sets it a little apart.



We have the inky art at each camera location, and the bright coloured stickmen in those locatrions.



This makes the colour difference very....alien? The stickman feel out there, because...they are.



(they are also in your walls)

notes.title: From Biorage to Stickman
notes.content:
HOW DID WE GET HERE?


Biorage was an old school FPS, Five Nights At Stickman is a satirical FNAF fangame.



My actual original plans predate the cancelled BitBox title!



I was planning on sticking to first person shooters, however, after messing around with a potential new and different FPS, I kinda felt meh about it.



Then came BitBox which did have an FPS as one of it's minigames. But in general bitbox was a major step in a different direction.



Then came FNAS, a wild idea I had in my head out of nowhere, and I kinda....loved it. SImple, but fun, really fun to make personally for me!



I WILL likely do FPS again in the future, but just not now.

notes.title: The cancelled game: BitBox
notes.content:
What WAS BitBox?


BitBox was originally supposed to be the game that releases august 1st. 



But what IS BitBox? BitBox was a 15 minigame collection, it had racing, horror, stories, survival etc.



Sadly, after technical issues with the Steam testers, and some installscript issues, the game got cancelled.



Kinda sad as it was an entire game ofcourse. But alas. This led me to FNAS. 


Is it lost media?


I'm afraid so. Perhaps one day I can put it on itch.io, but the technical issuess might persist.



I CAN give you 2 things.



The logo (as seen in this post)



The descriptions of the minigames: 


🎮 Featured Minigames:
Demon Slayer – A wave-based arena shooter where enemy spawns are randomized. Rack up high scores and survive the onslaught.



Spike Race – Race against AI in fast-paced, procedurally generated environments—complete with unexpected random events like rain... or giraffes.



Lunar Watcher – A mysterious, story-driven exploration on the moon. Collect anomalies and uncover fragments of lore... but be warned—you’re not alone.



Meltdown – You're trapped in a submarine with an unstable reactor. Keep things under control and chat with crewmates—if you can.



Dragon Boss Fight – Face off against three dragons, each with randomly chosen attacks. Dodge, strike, and survive the chaos.



Cube Field – An experimental playground where dynamic cubes react to your mouse—and your microphone.



Cave-In – You're trapped in a collapsing cave. Collect lore fragments and try to escape before everything crumbles around you.



Gardening – Harvest fruits to gain strange abilities like high jumps, speed boosts, shrinking, first-person view... and possibly encounter some very determined snails.



Case Opener – Open loot cases packed with weapons across four rarity tiers. Simple, satisfying, addictive.



Biorage Win/Lose – A chance-based game tied to the developer’s previous title, Biorage. Win something... or don’t.



Make Them Happy – You will make them happy... or else.



Overthinker – A personal, emotional story-driven experience.



Tank & Balls – A tactical tank shooter with bouncing, blocking balls that change how every round plays out. Outsmart the AI across dynamic maps.



Knight Parkour – Brutally hard 2D platforming. The only way is up—but the higher you go, the more intense the fall.



3v3 Warfare – A team-based 3v3 shooter with randomly selected maps and weapons. First team to 15 points wins—good luck.

notes.title: Five Nights, Zero Chill.
notes.content:
What exactly are the stickmen up to?


Well well well, we have 4 stickmen.


[olist]
Eclipse, this googly boogly has long tentacle like structure, it's calm most of the time, but when he gets mad......you wish you were dead.



Omega, this box of a stickman is a bit quirky at times, it likes the left side a lot...it's not shy from cameras and will sometimes try to pose or show off his BOXY structure. 



Silver, this blue weirdo has floating eyes, nobody really knows why or how, he's also a bit goofy at times but more serious compared to his other stickmen.



 Flapper, he be flapping



 "REDACTED: REDACTED REDACTED REDACTED REDACTED REDACTED REDACTED REDACTED REDACTED



Phone call man, he be calling you every night, giving you neat tips and threatening you kindly.



You, you are someone with a past, you are someone familiar, yet what you seek only lies at the end of your journey.
[/olist]

Meet the office


The gameplay is classic FNAF1.



You have 2 doors, limited power, some lights to shine if a stickman is at the door, many cameras.



You have to survive. Trust me, you do not want to fail. The stickmen have.....a way with...defeated nightguards.



Let's just hope you don't like spaghettification...

notes.title: Why did I choose stickmen?
notes.content:
I truly worked billions of hours to create these stickmen.

The inspiration came to me on a random day at a random time. 

Like the great Freddy Fazbear once said "It is time for stickman".

From that moment....nothing was the same. and the Stickmen came to life.

I'm happy to share this experience with y'all. It will change anyone daring enough to play it.
